title: Bi Sheng's invention of clay movable type, Song China
note: Documented by Shen Kuo in the Dream Pool Essays (Mengxi Bitan, c. 1088); earliest documented movable type, firing carved clay types into iron forms.

title: Jikji printed with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa Temple, Cheongju, Goryeo Korea
note: Oldest surviving book printed with movable metal type, 78 years before Gutenberg's Bible; preserved at the Bibliothèque nationale de France and inscribed on UNESCO Memory of the World.

title: Establishment of the first printing press in the Americas by Juan Pablos in Mexico City
note: Branch of the Cromberger Seville printing house; published bilingual catechisms in Spanish and Nahuatl, inaugurating print culture in the Americas.

title: Introduction of the printing press to India at Goa and earliest Tamil printings
note: First European press in Asia established at the College of Saint Paul in Goa; led to casting of Indic metal types and early Tamil printings by Henrique Henriques.
